|strategy=By [mailto:Rogue35432@aol.com Brian Monday (Gold 42)]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/comewithme.html</ref>

This often overlooked card can really give the Light Side fits. With the increased use of starships, thanks to cards like [[Haven]] and [[Leia Of Alderaan]], this card can be used to help thwart your opponent's strategy. Best of all, it's immune to [[Alter (Dark){{!}}Alter]], so there's no chance of your opponent cancelling it!

The most obvious use is against the Rebel [[Red Leader{{!}}Leader]] cards. A destiny draw of 3 or higher will knock out any starfighter's permanent pilot, and [[Red Leader In Red 1]] or [[Gold Leader In Gold 1]] are the most annoying permanent pilots in the game for the Dark Side. Getting rid of the automatic destiny draw from those cards can often turn the tides of a battle to the Dark Side's favor, since the [[Haven]] deck normally utilizes generic starfighters spread out to drain, with the Rebel [[Red Leader{{!}}Leader]] cards as the heavy support.

A more subtle use is to use [[Come With Me]] on one of your own starfighters to add a better pilot aboard. For example, you could deploy the Obsidians, then use [[Come With Me]] on [[Obsidian 8]], and replace it's permanent pilot with one of the myriad ability 2 pilots available to keep a destiny draw together.

Combos:

[[Come With Me]] + [[R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo){{!}}R2-Q2]] + [[The Dark Path]] + [[Death Star Assault Squadron]] + [[Grand Moff Tarkin]]: Use [[R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo){{!}}R2-Q2]] and [[The Dark Path]] to set up a 3+ destiny, then knock out [[DS-61-2]] or [[DS-61-3]] and replace him with [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] to get the [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]/[[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] destiny cancelling ability.

[[Come With Me]] + [[R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo){{!}}R2-Q2]] + [[The Dark Path]] + [[Zuckuss]] or [[Darth Vader]]: Knock out any Dark Side starfighter's permanent pilot and replace it with an ability 4+ pilot, guaranteeing a destiny draw.

[[Come With Me]] + Rebel [[Red Leader{{!}}Leader]] ships: Get rid of those pesky, destiny-drawing permanent pilots.
|rulings=* If this card removes a unique permanent pilot, that persona's uniqueness still applies (e.g. if played on [[Gold Leader In Gold 1]], the character [[Dutch]] still cannot be deployed).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Come%20With%20Me</ref>
* An unpiloted starship cannot use its game text (e.g. [[Lando In Millennium Falcon]] cannot use the immune to attrition &lt; 5 text), but once the starship is piloted again, the starship's game text becomes usable again (except text that specifically says it comes from the removed permanent pilot).
